ex.en: Always keep a backup of important files.
ex.zh: 重要檔案一定要備份。

ex.en: I restored my photos from the backup.
ex.zh: 我從備份中還原了照片。

backup.en: an extra copy of computer files kept in case the first are lost

ex.en: The police officer called for backup.
ex.zh: 警員請求支援。

ex.en: We have a backup plan in case it rains.
ex.zh: 我們有下雨時的備用方案。

backup.en: extra help or extra things that can be used when needed

ex.en: Streaming video uses a lot of bandwidth.
ex.zh: 串流影片很耗頻寬。

ex.en: We need more bandwidth for the video calls.
ex.zh: 視訊會議需要更大的頻寬。

bandwidth.en: the amount of data that can be sent over a connection in a set time

ex.en: I don't have the bandwidth to take on another project.
ex.zh: 我沒有餘力再接一個專案。

ex.en: Let's talk next week when I have more bandwidth.
ex.zh: 等我下週比較有空時再談吧。

bandwidth.en: the time and energy that you have to deal with something

ex.en: This battery is about to run out of juice.
ex.zh: 這顆電池快沒電了。

ex.en: You need to pay extra for the batteries.
ex.zh: 電池要另外付費。

ex.en: The car won't start because the battery has run down.
ex.zh: 車子發不動，因為電瓶沒電了。

battery.en: a small object that stores and gives out electricity

ex.en: The baseball game was called off due to rain.
ex.zh: 棒球比賽因雨取消了。

ex.en: If it is fine tomorrow, we will play baseball.
ex.zh: 如果明天天氣好，我們就去打棒球。

ex.en: He is fond of watching baseball games on TV.
ex.zh: 他喜歡看電視轉播的棒球比賽。

baseball.en: a team game played with a bat and a small hard ball

ex.en: Two years ago I could not play basketball at all.
ex.zh: 兩年前我完全不會打籃球。

ex.en: Tom and his friends played basketball all afternoon.
ex.zh: 湯姆和朋友打了一整個下午的籃球。

ex.en: I watched the basketball game on TV.
ex.zh: 我看了電視轉播的籃球賽。

basketball.en: a team game in which players throw a ball through a high net

ex.en: Her father is a banker in Hong Kong.
ex.zh: 她父親是香港的銀行家。

ex.en: Investment bankers often work long hours.
ex.zh: 投資銀行從業人員常常工時很長。

banker.en: a person who has an important job in a place that keeps and lends money

ex.en: My mother often bakes apple pies for us.
ex.zh: 媽媽常常烤蘋果派給我們吃。

ex.en: These are cakes that she baked herself.
ex.zh: 這些是她自己烤的蛋糕。

ex.en: There is an oven to bake bread in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 廚房裡有烤箱可以烤麵包。

bake.en: to cook food in an oven

ex.en: Open the window. It's baking hot in here.
ex.zh: 打開窗戶吧，這裡熱得像烤箱。

ex.en: It's baking hot outside today.
ex.zh: 今天外面熱得要命。

ex.en: There are a lot of eggs in the basket.
ex.zh: 籃子裡有很多雞蛋。

ex.en: She was carrying a basket full of flowers.
ex.zh: 她提著一籃滿滿的花。

ex.en: There are some apples in the basket.
ex.zh: 籃子裡有一些蘋果。

basket.en: a container made of thin strips, used for carrying things

bankrupt.zh: 破產的（go bankrupt 破產、倒閉）

ex.en: The company went bankrupt.
ex.zh: 公司破產了。

ex.en: Many small companies went bankrupt.
ex.zh: 許多小公司倒閉了。

ex.en: He was declared bankrupt.
ex.zh: 他被宣告破產。

bankrupt.en: not able to pay money that is owed

ex.en: The lawsuit nearly bankrupted the company.
ex.zh: 這場官司差點讓公司破產。

ex.en: Bad investments bankrupted him.
ex.zh: 錯誤的投資讓他破產了。

bankrupt.en: to cause a person or company to lose all their money

ex.en: The family is eating breakfast on the balcony.
ex.zh: 一家人在陽台上吃早餐。

ex.en: What are you doing on the balcony?
ex.zh: 你在陽台上做什麼？

ex.en: Why don't you go out on the balcony and get some sun?
ex.zh: 你何不去陽台曬曬太陽？

balcony.en: a small platform outside an upper window, or upper seats in a theater

ex.en: They cleaned everything, from the basement to the attic.
ex.zh: 他們從地下室到閣樓全都打掃了。

ex.en: The basement was flooded.
ex.zh: 地下室淹水了。

ex.en: I know I left it somewhere down here in the basement.
ex.zh: 我知道我把它放在地下室的某個地方了。

basement.en: a room or floor of a building below the ground

ex.en: I'm going to the bakery now. Do you want anything?
ex.zh: 我現在要去麵包店，你要買什麼嗎？

ex.en: The bakery is closed.
ex.zh: 麵包店打烊了。

ex.en: The girl who works at the bakery is cute.
ex.zh: 在麵包店工作的那個女生很可愛。

bakery.en: a place where bread and cakes are made or sold

ex.en: We'll have a barbecue at the beach.
ex.zh: 我們要在海邊烤肉。

ex.en: I love barbecue.
ex.zh: 我很喜歡烤肉。

barbecue.en: an outdoor meal or party where food is cooked over a fire

ex.en: Barbecuing is forbidden here.
ex.zh: 此處禁止烤肉。

ex.en: We barbecued chicken in the backyard.
ex.zh: 我們在後院烤雞肉。

barbecue.en: to cook food over a fire outdoors

ex.en: The balloon was caught in the tree.
ex.zh: 氣球卡在樹上了。

ex.en: Tom is inflating a balloon.
ex.zh: 湯姆在吹氣球。

balloon.en: a small rubber bag filled with air or gas

ex.en: Costs ballooned during the project.
ex.zh: 專案進行期間成本暴增。

ex.en: His debt ballooned to over a million dollars.
ex.zh: 他的債務暴增到一百多萬元。

balloon.en: to quickly become much larger or greater

ex.en: In U.S. bakeries, a "baker's dozen" is 13, not 12.
ex.zh: 在美國的麵包店，「麵包師傅的一打」是十三個，不是十二個。

ex.en: The baker gets up at four every morning.
ex.zh: 那位麵包師傅每天早上四點起床。

ex.en: My uncle works as a baker in Tainan.
ex.zh: 我叔叔在台南當麵包師傅。

baker.en: a person who makes and sells bread and cakes

ex.en: The company filed for bankruptcy last year.
ex.zh: 這家公司去年申請破產。

ex.en: Poor management led the firm into bankruptcy.
ex.zh: 經營不善導致公司破產。

bankruptcy.en: the state of being unable to pay money that is owed

ex.en: I always carry a laptop in my backpack.
ex.zh: 我的背包裡總是放著筆電。

ex.en: Please put your backpack under the seat.
ex.zh: 請把背包放在座位下方。

backpack.en: a bag carried on the back

ex.en: We went backpacking across Europe last summer.
ex.zh: 我們去年夏天去歐洲自助旅行。

ex.en: He backpacked through Southeast Asia after college.
ex.zh: 他大學畢業後到東南亞當背包客。

backpack.en: to travel cheaply carrying your things in a bag on your back

ex.en: The awards dinner will be held in the hotel ballroom.
ex.zh: 頒獎晚宴將在飯店宴會廳舉行。

ex.en: The ballroom can hold up to 500 guests.
ex.zh: 宴會廳最多可容納 500 位賓客。

ballroom.en: a large room used for dances and big parties

ex.en: Bacteria are so small that they cannot be seen with the naked eye.
ex.zh: 細菌小到肉眼看不見。

ex.en: A cell phone is as contaminated with bacteria as a toilet is.
ex.zh: 手機上的細菌跟馬桶一樣多。

bacteria.en: very small living things, some of which cause disease

ex.en: Wine is put in barrels to mature.
ex.zh: 葡萄酒放在桶裡熟成。

ex.en: Oil prices rose to 90 dollars a barrel.
ex.zh: 油價漲到每桶 90 美元。

barrel.en: a large round container for liquids

ex.en: He was released on bail.
ex.zh: 他獲准交保。

ex.en: The judge set bail at fifty thousand dollars.
ex.zh: 法官把保釋金定為五萬美元。

bail.en: money paid so that an accused person can wait outside prison for the trial

ex.en: The government bailed out the failing banks.
ex.zh: 政府對瀕臨倒閉的銀行紓困。

ex.en: My brother bailed me out when I lost my job.
ex.zh: 我失業時哥哥出手幫了我。

bail.en: to help a person or company out of money trouble

ex.en: Tom took a step backward.
ex.zh: 湯姆後退了一步。

ex.en: You've put your hat on backwards.
ex.zh: 你把帽子戴反了。

backward.en: toward the back or in the opposite direction

ex.en: Some people think the old system is backward.
ex.zh: 有些人認為舊制度很落後。

ex.en: The factory still uses backward technology.
ex.zh: 這家工廠仍在使用落後的技術。

backward.zh: bend over backward：竭盡全力（幫忙、討好）

ex.en: He bent over backward to please his wife.
ex.zh: 他想盡辦法討好太太。

ex.en: The hotel staff bent over backward to help us.
ex.zh: 飯店員工竭盡所能地幫助我們。

backward.en: to try very hard to help or please someone

ex.en: We use last year's sales as a baseline.
ex.zh: 我們以去年的銷售額作為基準。

ex.en: Baseline data will be collected before the test.
ex.zh: 測試前會先收集基準資料。

baseline.en: a starting level used to compare later results

ex.en: I'll be back in ten minutes.
ex.zh: 我十分鐘後回來。

ex.en: Please call me back later.
ex.zh: 請晚點回電給我。

back.en: to or at a place where you were before

ex.en: My back hurts after sitting all day.
ex.zh: 坐了一整天，我的背好痛。

ex.en: He carried his son on his back.
ex.zh: 他把兒子背在背上。

back.en: the part of the body from the neck to the waist, behind the chest

ex.en: Please sit in the back of the room.
ex.zh: 請坐在教室後面。

ex.en: The answers are at the back of the book.
ex.zh: 答案在書的最後面。

back.en: the part of something that is farthest from the front

ex.en: He backed us up during that incident.
ex.zh: 那次事件中他支持我們。

ex.en: The manager backed my proposal.
ex.zh: 經理支持我的提案。

ex.en: Look in the rear-view mirror before backing up.
ex.zh: 倒車前先看後照鏡。

ex.en: Remember to back up your files.
ex.zh: 記得備份你的檔案。

back.en: to drive a vehicle in reverse, or to make an extra copy of computer files

ex.en: The idea is not in itself a bad one.
ex.zh: 這個想法本身並不壞。

ex.en: Many TV programs have a bad influence on children.
ex.zh: 許多電視節目對孩子有不良影響。

ex.en: I have a bad cold.
ex.zh: 我得了重感冒。

ex.en: The traffic was really bad this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上塞車很嚴重。

ex.en: The whole plan is only based on his personal opinions.
ex.zh: 整個計畫只是根據他的個人意見。

ex.en: You can't judge a person based on clothing.
ex.zh: 不能以衣著來判斷一個人。

ex.en: Your interpretation is based merely on the surface meaning.
ex.zh: 你的理解只是根據字面上的意思。

base.en: to use something as the starting point or main part of something else

ex.en: This city lies at the base of a mountain.
ex.zh: 這座城市位在山腳下。

ex.en: There is a crack in the base of the vase.
ex.zh: 花瓶底部有一道裂痕。

base.zh: 基本、基準（base salary 底薪）

ex.en: His remuneration consists of a base salary plus commissions.
ex.zh: 他的薪酬包括底薪加佣金。

ex.en: The base price does not include tax.
ex.zh: 基本價格不含稅。

base.en: the main or lowest amount that other things are added to

ex.en: The company's base is in Taichung.
ex.zh: 這家公司的據點在台中。

ex.en: We have a large customer base in Asia.
ex.zh: 我們在亞洲有廣大的客群。

base.en: a main place where a group works or lives, or a group of regular supporters

ex.en: I ran across an old friend near the bank.
ex.zh: 我在銀行附近碰到一位老朋友。

ex.en: I made a deposit of $1,000 at the bank.
ex.zh: 我在銀行存了一千美元。

ex.en: In Britain, the banks open at 9:00 in the morning.
ex.zh: 在英國，銀行早上九點開門。

bank.en: a business that keeps money safe and lends money

ex.en: We had a picnic on the bank of the river.
ex.zh: 我們在河岸邊野餐。

ex.en: There are many trees along the river banks.
ex.zh: 河岸兩旁有很多樹。

bank.en: the land along the side of a river

ex.en: My friends and I often go to the bar.
ex.zh: 我和朋友常去酒吧。

ex.en: Let's meet at the hotel bar at eight.
ex.zh: 我們八點在飯店酒吧碰面。

bar.en: a place where people go to drink alcohol

ex.en: I ate a chocolate bar for lunch.
ex.zh: 我午餐吃了一條巧克力棒。

ex.en: Can I have a bar of soap?
ex.zh: 可以給我一塊肥皂嗎？

bar.en: a long, narrow piece of something hard

ex.en: Soldiers barred the way to the city.
ex.zh: 士兵們擋住了通往城市的路。

ex.en: He was barred from entering the building.
ex.zh: 他被禁止進入大樓。

bar.en: to stop someone from going somewhere or doing something

ex.en: The prisoner was behind bars for two months.
ex.zh: 那名囚犯坐了兩個月的牢。

ex.en: He is a killer, he should be behind bars!
ex.zh: 他是兇手，應該被關進牢裡！

ex.en: The baby was sound asleep in her mother's arms.
ex.zh: 嬰兒在媽媽懷裡睡得很熟。

ex.en: The babies are taken care of by volunteers.
ex.zh: 這些嬰兒由志工照顧。

ex.en: It is easy for babies to get sick.
ex.zh: 嬰兒很容易生病。

baby.en: a very young child who cannot yet walk or talk

ex.en: There is no scientific basis for these claims.
ex.zh: 這些說法沒有科學根據。

ex.en: Your theory has no scientific basis.
ex.zh: 你的理論並沒有科學根據。

ex.en: Food, clothing and shelter are the basis of life.
ex.zh: 衣食住是生活的基礎。

basis.en: the facts or ideas that something is built on

basis.zh: on a … basis：以…的方式／頻率

ex.en: We conduct safety inspections here on a regular basis.
ex.zh: 我們定期在這裡進行安全檢查。

ex.en: She works here on a part-time basis.
ex.zh: 她在這裡兼職工作。

basis.en: used to say how or how often something is done

ex.en: This law will deprive us of our basic rights.
ex.zh: 這項法律會剝奪我們的基本權利。

ex.en: I think your basic theory is wrong.
ex.zh: 我認為你的基本理論是錯的。

ex.en: The workers didn't get their basic wage.
ex.zh: 工人沒有領到基本工資。

basic.en: most important and necessary, forming the base of something

ex.en: This course teaches the basics of accounting.
ex.zh: 這門課教會計的基礎知識。

ex.en: Let's go back to the basics.
ex.zh: 我們回到最基本的部分吧。

basic.en: the simple and most important parts of a subject

ex.en: They are considered the greatest rock band in history.
ex.zh: 他們被認為是史上最偉大的搖滾樂團。

ex.en: The band is now doing a sound check.
ex.zh: 樂團正在試音。

ex.en: I would love to sing with your band.
ex.zh: 我很樂意和你們樂團一起唱歌。

band.en: a group of musicians who play music together

band.zh: 帶子、帶狀物；（收入、年齡等的）範圍

ex.en: She tied her hair back with a rubber band.
ex.zh: 她用橡皮筋把頭髮綁起來。

ex.en: People in this income band pay less tax.
ex.zh: 這個收入級距的人繳的稅比較少。

band.en: a thin strip of material, or a range between two limits

ex.en: We need to band together to beat the enemy.
ex.zh: 我們必須團結起來才能打敗敵人。

ex.en: The neighbors banded together to clean the park.
ex.zh: 鄰居們團結起來清掃公園。

band.en: to join with other people for a shared purpose

ex.en: I asked the boy to throw the ball back.
ex.zh: 我請那個男孩把球丟回來。

ex.en: This boy often breaks our window with his ball.
ex.zh: 這個男孩常常用球打破我們的窗戶。

ex.en: Cats love to run after balls of wool.
ex.zh: 貓喜歡追毛線球。

ball.en: a round object used in games and sports

ex.en: She wore a beautiful dress to the ball.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件漂亮的禮服去參加舞會。

ex.en: The hotel hosts a charity ball every year.
ex.zh: 這家飯店每年舉辦慈善舞會。

ball.en: a large formal party with dancing

ex.en: There is a castle in the background of the picture.
ex.zh: 照片的背景是一座城堡。

ex.en: You will need to bring two passport-sized photos of yourself taken with a white background.
ex.zh: 你需要帶兩張白色背景的護照尺寸照片。

ex.en: I can hear music in the background.
ex.zh: 我聽得到背景音樂。

background.en: the part of a picture or scene that is behind the main things

ex.en: Tom has a veterinary background.
ex.zh: 湯姆有獸醫背景。

ex.en: She has a background in marketing.
ex.zh: 她有行銷背景。

background.en: a person's family, education and past experience

ex.en: Can you give me some background on this project?
ex.zh: 你能給我一些這個專案的背景資料嗎？

ex.en: The article explains the background of the conflict.
ex.zh: 這篇文章說明了這場衝突的來龍去脈。

background.en: facts about the past that help you understand a situation

ex.en: The bag was too heavy for me to move.
ex.zh: 那個袋子太重了，我搬不動。

ex.en: Could you carry my bags for me?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我提袋子嗎？

ex.en: Let me help you. Your bag looks very heavy.
ex.zh: 我來幫你吧，你的包包看起來很重。

bag.en: a container made of paper, plastic or cloth for carrying things

ex.en: This is the place where the battle took place.
ex.zh: 這裡就是那場戰役發生的地點。

ex.en: The French were defeated at the Battle of Waterloo.
ex.zh: 法軍在滑鐵盧戰役中戰敗。

ex.en: Making a good start is half the battle.
ex.zh: 好的開始是成功的一半。

ex.en: It was a long battle to win the contract.
ex.zh: 爭取到這份合約是一場長期抗戰。

battle.en: a hard struggle to win or achieve something

ex.en: Layla was battling cancer.
ex.zh: 蕾拉當時正在與癌症搏鬥。

ex.en: The company is battling rising costs.
ex.zh: 公司正努力對抗不斷上漲的成本。

battle.en: to try very hard to defeat something difficult

ex.en: Basically, I agree with your opinion.
ex.zh: 基本上我同意你的意見。

ex.en: Basically, we need more time.
ex.zh: 基本上，我們需要更多時間。

ex.en: The two phones are basically the same.
ex.zh: 這兩支手機基本上一樣。

ex.en: He was banned from practising medicine.
ex.zh: 他被禁止行醫。

ex.en: Germany is to ban employers from snooping on Facebook.
ex.zh: 德國將禁止雇主在臉書上窺探員工。

ex.en: Smoking is banned in all public buildings.
ex.zh: 所有公共建築都禁止吸菸。

ban.en: to say officially that something is not allowed

ex.en: The government announced a ban on plastic bags.
ex.zh: 政府宣布禁用塑膠袋。

ex.en: The ban will take effect next month.
ex.zh: 這項禁令將於下個月生效。

ban.en: an official rule that says something is not allowed

ex.en: Tom was badly injured in a traffic accident.
ex.zh: 湯姆在車禍中受了重傷。

ex.en: My car was badly damaged in the accident.
ex.zh: 我的車在事故中嚴重受損。

badly.en: to a serious or severe degree

ex.en: Tom speaks French so badly that he's often misunderstood.
ex.zh: 湯姆法文說得很差，常常被人誤會。

ex.en: The meeting went badly, and nobody was happy.
ex.zh: 會議進行得很不順利，大家都不開心。

badly.en: in a poor way or at a low standard

ex.en: I will badly miss you if you leave Japan.
ex.zh: 如果你離開日本，我會非常想念你。

ex.en: We badly need more staff in the sales department.
ex.zh: 我們業務部非常需要更多人手。

badly.en: to a great degree, used with need, want or miss

ex.en: I was taking a bath when the telephone rang.
ex.zh: 我在洗澡時電話響了。

ex.en: She prefers baths rather than showers.
ex.zh: 比起淋浴，她比較喜歡泡澡。

bath.en: an act of washing your body in a tub of water

ex.en: The apartment has two bedrooms and one bath.
ex.zh: 這間公寓有兩房一衛浴。

ex.en: I filled the bath with hot water.
ex.zh: 我在浴缸裡放滿了熱水。

bath.en: a large container for washing the body in, or the room that has one

ex.en: Trade barriers were lifted after the war ended.
ex.zh: 戰爭結束後，貿易障礙就被解除了。

ex.en: Language can be a barrier to communication.

barrier.en: something that makes it difficult for things or people to happen or to join

ex.zh: 她在盆裡裝滿溫水。

ex.zh: 他用球棒擊球。

bat.en: a wooden stick used to hit a ball in some games

barber.en: a person whose job is to cut men's hair

ex.zh: 我今天要去理髮。

barber.en: a shop where men go to have their hair cut

ex.zh: 酒保推薦了一款當地啤酒。

barkeeper.en: a person who serves drinks in a place where alcohol is sold

ex.zh: 我們獲得在這個海灣捕魚的特權。

bay.zh: （特定用途的）區域、隔間（如 loading bay 裝卸區）

ex.zh: 卡車正在裝卸區等候。

ex.zh: 請把車停在訪客停車格。

bay.en: a marked area or space used for a particular purpose

ex.zh: 這件洋裝買得很划算。

bargain.en: something that is cheaper than its usual price

ex.zh: 她很會殺價。

ex.zh: 我有時會聽到爸爸在浴室裡唱歌。

ex.zh: 不好意思，洗手間在哪裡？

backbone.en: the main part that gives strength and support, or the courage to act

ex.zh: 護士輕柔地給我的頭纏上繃帶。

ex.zh: 他用繃帶把傷口包紮起來。

ex.zh: 護理師幫我扭傷的手腕包上繃帶。

ex.zh: 他自己把手指上的傷口包紮好。

bandage.en: to wrap a long strip of cloth around an injury

ex.zh: 她去年取得了英國文學的學士學位。

ex.zh: 他正在攻讀商學學士學位。

ex.zh: 全家人一起去教會參加寶寶的洗禮。

ex.zh: 他像野蠻人一樣用手抓東西吃。

ex.zh: 過去私生子往往無法繼承家族的土地。

bastard.en: an old and insulting word for a child whose parents were not married (offensive)

ballot.en: a piece of paper used to vote, or the act of voting

ex.zh: 政府批准了對這家航空公司的紓困方案。

ex.zh: 這家銀行需要紓困才能存活。

ex.zh: 中國提供給哥倫比亞的第三批疫苗已經運抵首都波哥大。

ex.zh: 她為派對烤了一批餅乾。

badge.en: a small card or piece of metal that shows who you are

ex.zh: 他把徽章別在背心上。

ex.zh: 他失去了平衡，從腳踏車上摔了下來。

ex.zh: 他失去了平衡，從梯子上摔了下來。

balance.en: a steady position in which you do not fall

ex.zh: 付款前請先查一下帳戶餘額。

balance.en: the amount of money in an account or still owed

ex.zh: 蔬果是均衡飲食不可或缺的。

ex.zh: 這些東西組成了一頓營養均衡的飯。

balance.en: having the right amounts of different things

ex.zh: 資產負債表列出公司的資產與負債。

ex.zh: 調酒師推薦一款使用本地柑橘調製的飲品。

ex.zh: 調酒師供應酒精飲料前必須確認證件。

bartender.en: a person who mixes and serves drinks at a place where alcohol is sold

ex.zh: 請問您有多少件行李？

ex.zh: 旅行時不要帶太多行李。

ex.zh: 請把你的行李放到這個秤上。

baggage.en: the bags and cases you take with you when you travel

ex.zh: 我們降落後在行李提領處碰面吧。

ex.zh: 她很會殺價。

ex.zh: 經過幾個小時的討價還價，他們終於成交。

ex.zh: 孩子們赤腳跑過沙灘。

ex.zh: 那個房間牆壁空蕩蕩的，幾乎沒有家具。

ex.zh: 最低限度就是在週五前完成報告。

ex.zh: 她從五歲起就在學芭蕾。

ex.zh: 我們去國家劇院看了一場芭蕾舞表演。

ex.zh: 單一個細菌可以非常快速地繁殖。

ex.zh: 這種細菌棲息在人的胃裡。

ex.zh: 我每天早餐都吃一根香蕉。

ex.zh: 她努力維持工作與休息均衡的生活作息。

ex.zh: 這篇文章對雙方的看法都做了公正的呈現。

ex.zh: 他是個冷靜又不偏激的人。

ex.zh: 我姊姊在銀行業工作，經常出差。

ex.zh: 網路銀行讓人在家就能輕鬆繳費。

ex.zh: 巴里在每次派對上都講最好笑的笑話。

ex.zh: 巴里整個下午都在油漆籬笆。

ex.zh: 芭芭拉在許多國家都是受歡迎的女孩名字。

ex.zh: 芭芭拉這個名字來自一個希臘文單字。

ex.zh: 這項計畫在全社區的支持下順利推動。

ex.zh: 她需要資金上的支持才能開自己的店。

ex.zh: 那位男爵住在一座大石頭城堡裡。

ex.zh: 故事中，男爵邀請村民們參加宴會。

ex.zh: 那位石油大亨捐錢給新醫院。

ex.zh: 他買下幾家報社後成了媒體大亨。

ex.zh: 他在一個本地搖滾樂團裡彈貝斯。

ex.zh: 他在教會合唱團裡唱男低音。

ex.zh: 今天早上我們在湖邊釣到一條大鱸魚。

ex.zh: 這間餐廳供應薑絲蒸海鱸魚。

ex.zh: 烘焙麵包是她週末最愛的嗜好。

ex.zh: 我奶奶教了我烘焙的基本功。

ex.zh: 她正在烤餅乾要給學校義賣。

ex.zh: 爸爸正在烤蛋糕，所以整個家聞起來好香。

ex.zh: 一條大布條橫掛在街上，宣傳慶典活動。

ex.zh: 士兵們跟在皇家旗幟後面行進。

ex.zh: 節慶期間，陽台上掛著一面巨大的旗幟。

ex.zh: 如果橫幅廣告擋住選單，請把它關掉。

ex.zh: 這棵老橡樹的樹皮又厚又粗糙。

ex.zh: 鹿有時在冬天會啃食幼樹的樹皮。

ex.zh: 那隻狗對著陌生人大聲吠叫。

ex.en: Our neighbor's dog barks all night and keeps us awake.
